title: ant-lora-closure：中文医疗问答 LoRA 数据配比受控消融与确定性评测（单机闭合实验）
description:
Controlled ablation of Chinese-medical instruction-data mixing ratios for LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-1.5B on a single RTX 2080 Ti: 91,306 dialogues cleaned to 58,787 (MinHash dedup), train/eval leakage removed (5 exact duplicates, then 172 overlapping items at the 500-question tier), four ratio arms x 3 seeds, McNemar paired tests, positive and shuffled-label controls. Headline is a negative result: no ratio gives a stable accuracy gain at this scale.

ant-lora-closure：把「对话数据配比」设计成受控消融的单机闭合实验；配比未带来稳定提升（负结果），全部产物与日志随仓库发布。
